reviews.text: Had such a lovely evening meal here with a friend. The food was fantastic but even better than that was the service. We had Fay as our main server, who was a delight from the start. They were welcoming and full of positivity and seemed such a genuinely lovely person. I had the vegan hell broth ramen (upon her recommendation), which was the perfect level of spice and absolutely delicious. After a mix up with one of our sides, Fay went the absolute extra mile to make sure we were still happy with our meal and dining experience (we would have been anyway). Also generally appreciated the inclusive atmosphere, with intersectional pride flags on display and genter neutral toilets too! All in all, great food, great service, great atmosphere. Would highly recommend 😊

reviews.author: Noth
reviews.text: Unfortunately, Ramen Ichiramen no longer offers a regular, non-halal Steak Tataki Ramen. Previously, customers could choose between halal and non-halal beef, but now the website states that all beef used in their ramen is halal, leaving customers with no alternative. I believe this is unfair to customers who, for personal or religious reasons, do not wish to consume halal meat. As a Christian, I do not believe I should be expected to accept a religiously prepared product when I previously had the option to choose otherwise. I fully respect the right of Muslim customers to choose halal food. However, I believe the same consideration should be given to customers who prefer non-halal meat. Previously, both options were available, but now only halal beef is offered, meaning that customers who do not want halal meat have lost their choice. In my opinion, a restaurant should respect the different dietary preferences and beliefs of all its customers rather than remove an option that was previously available. Unfortunately, this change has left me disappointed. I would like to see Ramen Ichiramen reintroduce the non-halal beef option for its Steak Tataki Ramen. One star due to the loss of choice and the lack of consideration for customers who do not wish to eat halal meat.

reviews.author: Nabanita Talukdar
reviews.text: I am writing about an incident at the Aberdeen branch on 12 October 2026 at approximately 20:10, while working as a part-time delivery driver. When I arrived, only two or three tables were occupied, yet the servers were gathered near the bar and I had to wait around 8–10 minutes just to get someone’s attention. When a server finally approached, I told him the order was ready and likely on the collection shelf. He checked the bag, insisted it was not the correct order, and walked away without properly resolving the issue. I tried to get another server’s attention, but he also initially ignored me. When he eventually came forward, he likewise claimed the bag was incorrect and appeared reluctant to check it properly. I had to insist that he verify the order number before he finally acknowledged that it was the correct bag. What disappointed me most was not simply the wasted time, but the lack of assistance, communication and professionalism throughout the interaction. Having several years of management experience myself, I understand that mistakes happen, but staff should be willing to check an order properly rather than dismissing a delivery driver who is simply trying to do their job. Delivery drivers’ time matters too, and we should not have to repeatedly chase staff for basic assistance or insist on a straightforward order-number check. I strongly encourage the management team to review this incident, including any available CCTV and order records, and address the staff conduct and collection procedures at this branch. I hope management takes this feedback seriously and ensures that delivery drivers are treated with the courtesy and professionalism they deserve.

reviews.author: kristina barkauskyte
reviews.text: Lovely Food, but Disappointing Customer Service Today, we visited Maki & Ramen with friends. This wasn’t our first visit, and there’s a reason we decided to come back! The food was absolutely lovely, as always, and the atmosphere was really nice too. Unfortunately, our experience took a disappointing turn when it came time to pay. When we approached the till and asked about our bill, the gentleman serving us already seemed visibly unhappy and irritated. However, things got even worse when we politely asked if we could pay separately. His reaction was completely unnecessary. He threw the card machine aside and looked at us as though we had asked for our food for free! We were honestly shocked by his attitude. Asking to split a bill is a perfectly normal request, and no customer should be made to feel uncomfortable or unwelcome for simply asking. Thankfully, another gentleman came over, and he was the complete opposite — very friendly, polite and happy to help us with exactly what we had asked for. We really appreciated his kindness and professionalism. Unfortunately, despite the delicious food and lovely atmosphere, the behaviour of the first staff member left a very unpleasant feeling and spoiled what had otherwise been a great visit. We genuinely enjoy coming to Maki & Ramen, which makes this experience even more disappointing. Good food brings customers in, but good customer service is what makes them want to return. Hopefully, this is something management will take seriously, as no customer deserves to be treated that way.

reviews.text: I would like to give a special mention to Cameron, the manager for his kindness towards us at the restaurant. He listened to our concerns, showed genuine understanding and treated us with respect and professionalism throughout. He was understanding of the religious significance of the situation and made sure the issue was addressed. Mistakes can happen in any restaurant, but the way a member of management responds makes all the difference. Cameron demonstrated excellent customer service, empathy and professionalism, and we genuinely appreciated how he dealt with everything. reviews.author: Isha Shah
reviews.text: Vegans be ware! They served me real eggs. Maybe it was a bad day in the restaurant was busy so I’d like to give people grace. But me and my friend both ordered Vegan Ramen from the Vegan menu and even asked the waiter what was the best vegan Ramen there was? When our balls came, they both had egg in it. My friend wasn’t Vegan so I asked her to try the egg and bacon. She said the egg tasted a real egg and the bacon didn’t. I then asked the waiter if the egg was real and he said yes, I looked at him shocked I asked him for a vegan Ramen instead of apologising he asked me are you sure? As if I didn’t mention Vegan Ramen enough? As a Vegan there’s stereotype we always talk about us being Vegan and yes, that was me so I’m pretty sure I mentioned me being Vegan at least five times in the ordering interaction. There was no accountability or apology which is absolutely crazy. We asked for tapwater and that never came so I had to ask for that two times before it did. I get restaurants are busy and packed but Lets Be real this mistake is absolutely insane. So Vegan, if you’re gonna eat it be absolutely aware that you could be getting served real animal products which is a scary thought.

reviews.text: I’ve been here 3 times and every time I’ve been here, the service has been terrible. Really long wait times for drinks and food, ended up waiting even longer for the bill. There’s a man that waits on tables, he has his hair in a bun and is quite muscular (didn’t catch his name) he was very rude, and gave us lip when we asked for chilli oil (that I’d already ordered), he went to bring out our food to the table and didn’t believe that we had ordered it so he quizzed us. When we asked him for the bill he was very dismissive, said he’d get someone and never did. We ended up asking 3 separate people for our bill, hence why it took so long. The male waiter was Very stand off-ish, and honestly he was terrible at his job. The girl with the ginger and blonde hair was so nice and such a diva. This place is clearly very very understaffed, even when they have an offer on and expect an influx of customers. Our drinks normally take about 25 minutes longer than the food, so this time we ordered wine to make sure there was very little to do in order to actually serve us our drinks. Won’t be going again, food is nice but that’s about it, nothing special. Wouldn’t recommend.

reviews.author: kyrell rc
reviews.text: Service was ridiculous… The only reason we visited was because of their £5 ramen deal advertised all over social media, so we thought we’d give it a go. The service was honestly ridiculous. My sister and I received our food, but my boyfriend and cousin were left waiting around 30 minutes for theirs. We had to tell the staff multiple times that their food hadn’t arrived, only for a waiter to ask us if we were sure nothing had come out, despite the empty spaces on the table making that pretty obvious. My sister and I had literally finished our meals by the time their food arrived. To make matters worse, we then waited around 20 minutes for the bill. We asked two members of staff, and one of them was walking back and forth serving other tables whilst seemingly ignoring us, despite making eye contact. We eventually had to get up and approach the staff ourselves just to get the bill. There was a complete lack of care and attention throughout the experience. The food itself was fine, but the service seriously let the whole visit down. I wouldn’t return based on this experience

reviews.author: Alex King
reviews.text: An absolutely wonderful experience at Maki & Ramen! We visited Maki & Ramen today for our son’s 4th birthday lunch, and we honestly couldn’t have asked for a better experience! From the moment we arrived, they made us feel so welcome and really went out of their way to make the occasion special. It meant so much to us to celebrate such an important little milestone there, and they helped make it a lovely memory for our family. The food was absolutely stunning — everything was beautifully presented, full of flavour, and delicious from start to finish. You can really tell the care and quality that goes into what they do. What stood out just as much as the food was the service. The team were so lovely, attentive and thoughtful, making our son’s birthday lunch feel extra special. Those little touches make all the difference, especially when celebrating with children. Thank you to the whole team at Maki & Ramen for making our little boy’s 4th birthday lunch so memorable. We left with full bellies, big smiles and some lovely memories. Amazing food, fantastic service and such a special atmosphere. We couldn’t recommend Maki & Ramen highly enough and will definitely be back! ❤️🍜
